description: Two awards a year for young women at NC high schools pursuing technology or engineering: $1,000 per year ($4,000 at a four-year school) plus a Lenovo laptop.
eligibility_text: Current senior at a North Carolina high school; rising female first-year student enrolling as an undergraduate at an accredited NC institution (four-year campus in the state or NC Community College System); NC resident for tuition; cumulative unweighted GPA of at least 3.0; intended major in technology or engineering.
